Revolution Red

革(かく)命(めい)ノ(ノ)赤(あか)kakumei NO aka

AKNP-0019

"A history of evil, alongside MEIKO."

mothy's twenty-second album featuring exclusively MEIKO-centric songs released on July 26, 2026. The album is licensed through KARENT and is available on YouTube, Apple Music, Amazon Japan, and Spotify.

Crossfade (Twitter) · Crossfade (YouTube) · Crossfade (niconico) · Scans

Tracklist

  1. Revolution Red
  2. Escape of Salmhofer the Witch
  3. The Imperial Princess Who Slumbers in the Grave, the Wicked Woman Who Guards It
  4. Evil Food Eater Conchita (2026 MEIKO Only Ver)
  5. A Hero's Armor is Always Crimson
  6. Conflict – Enbizaka
  7. Banica Concerto!!
  8. Fictional Masquerade
  9. grEAT journey
  10. Evil Food Eater Conchita (2009 V1 Ver)

Notes

  • The album was illustrated by Ichika.
  • mothy noted on Twitter that the songs in the album aren't necessarily in chronological order.
  • The album booklet features the names of the focus characters and a brief description.
  • The digital release of the album only features the four new songs (Revolution Red, The Imperial Princess Who Slumbers in the Grave, the Wicked Woman Who Guards It, Evil Food Eater Conchita (2026 MEIKO Only Ver), and Conflict – Enbizaka) along with their Off Vocal versions.
